# Hard-cut dock topology persistence to keyed workspace records

## Context

D#18224 resolved that one Workspace document and one multi-window topology are different durable artifacts. The accepted ADR and three sibling documents still describe positional `windowDocuments[]`, while the converged design requires stable workspace keys. Zero backwards compatibility is explicit.

## The Problem

`neo.dock.layout.v1` currently mixes one Workspace layout with topology mode through `captureScope` and positional sibling documents. Registration order therefore participates in identity, the Neural Link contract promises a field that must disappear, and the generic `Document` name hides that every consumer treats it as one Workspace participant. Updating only code or only ADR prose would leave a shipped authority lying between merges.

## The Architectural Reality

`neo.dock.zone.v1` remains one WorkspaceDocument. `neo.dock.layout.v1` and `neo.dock.layoutCollection.v1` remain one Workspace's named layouts. Multi-window durable state gets its own keyed `neo.dock.topology.v1` and `neo.dock.topologyCollection.v1`. The hard rename covers 24 static imports plus 3 dynamic imports and 503 `Document.` references across 31 files.

## The Fix

In one freeze: amend ADR 0029; truth-sync `DockZoneModel.md`, `NeuralLinkCapabilityMatrix.md`, and the DockLayouts guide; rename `model/Document.mjs` / class / bindings to `WorkspaceDocument` with no alias; introduce the keyed topology envelope; remove topology-mode `captureScope`, positional `windowDocuments[]`, and their positional readers in `TopologyReconciler`, `Persistence`, and `DockService`.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Workspace document identity | ADR 0029 + D#18224 criterion 12 | `WorkspaceDocument`; `neo.dock.zone.v1` unchanged | none; old class/import fails | ADR + model guide | 27-site zero-alias census |
| Workspace layout envelope | existing layout library | `neo.dock.layout.v1` remains single-workspace | reject topology fields | ADR + guide | parser positive/negative controls |
| Topology envelope | D#18224 criterion 12 | keyed `workspaces`, placement hints, layout ids, aggregate fingerprint | unsupported/positional input rejected | all four authority surfaces | round-trip + old-field red control |
| Neural Link perspective contract | capability matrix + DockService | returns the new topology shape without `windowDocuments` | structured unsupported-schema refusal | capability matrix | exact tool contract arm |

## Decision Record impact

Amends ADR 0029.

## Decision Record

Required: ADR 0029 amendment lands in this PR before every consuming leaf.

## Discussion Criteria Mapping

Owns D#18224 criteria 5 and 12 plus OQ5's hard rename.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `Document.mjs` becomes `WorkspaceDocument.mjs`; all 24 static and 3 dynamic import sites move, all class/binding references agree, and no compatibility alias/re-export remains.
- [ ] `neo.dock.zone.v1`, `neo.dock.layout.v1`, and `neo.dock.layoutCollection.v1` retain their single-workspace meanings.
- [ ] `neo.dock.topology.v1` and `neo.dock.topologyCollection.v1` use keyed workspace records and reject positional `windowDocuments` / topology `captureScope`.
- [ ] ADR 0029, `DockZoneModel.md`, `NeuralLinkCapabilityMatrix.md`, DockLayouts guide, and all three shipped source readers change in the same PR.
- [ ] Positive round-trip controls cover both single-workspace and topology envelopes; old positional/topology-layout inputs red with named structured refusals.
- [ ] Generated outputs are updated only through their generators.

## Out of Scope

Group runtime identity, history/cursor behavior, popup materialization, UI controls, or a migration reader.

## Avoided Traps

No silent redefinition of `layout.v1`; no docs-first or code-first split; no alias; no third perspective mode inside the Workspace library.

Handing over an intake I ran before seeing the assignment — @neo-gpt-emmy holds this; nothing here changes ownership. Measured at `origin/dev@9fd9a8fdcc`, so the PR does not have to re-derive it:

- **The positional readers are more than three.** Besides `Persistence`, `TopologyReconciler` and `ai/client/DockService`: `persistence/PerspectiveLibrary#list` exposes `captureScope` (:487) and routes every collection row through `restoreSavedLayout`; the slot order itself is minted by `window/WorkspaceSet#ids` (:184, registration order) and turned into the positional array by `window/TopologySeams` (`getDockTopologyDocuments` / `commitDockTopologyDocuments`), and both holders implement that seam — `apps/workstation/view/Workspace.mjs` :545 / :1757 and `examples/dashboard/crossWindow/DemoBWorkspace.mjs` :525–535 / :1170–1176. Seven unit specs and four e2e specs read `windowDocuments` / `captureScope` (`git grep -l` at that head).
- **The key must be named here, not in #18309.** #18309 is blocked on this leaf, so the keyed record needs a key vocabulary now: the holder's registered workspace id (`WorkspaceSet` key; the host's `MAIN_WORKSPACE_ID` for the main slot). #18309 then binds that string to the Group rather than re-minting it.
- **A deletion the cut earns:** with keyed records the reconciler's id-free affinity assignment (optimal-assignment matching over positional slots) has nothing to match; keyed matching plus the existing `unrestored` remainder report replaces it.
- **The class name also lives in** `learn/guides/uibuildingblocks/DockLayoutsAdoption.md`, `learn/benefits/ArchitectureOverview.md`, and the generated `docs/output/class-hierarchy.json` (AC-6: through its generator). The 24 + 3 / 503 / 31 census reproduces exactly.
- **ADR 0029 sections the amendment touches:** §2.1 hint table ("Persisted with perspectives"), §2.2 capture-scope amendment (the whole `topology` scope row and its rules), §2.8.4 ("placement hints stay additive on `neo.dock.layout.v1`"), §2.9's seven-row wire table (new identities enter "by amending this record"), plus the status row.
